meta.name: Everwood: A Thanksgiving Tale
meta.description:
Everwood · Season 1, Episode 11 · aired 2002-11-25

Delia yearns for a Thanksgiving dinner just like her mother prepared. A recluse who broke off all family ties is asked to be a kidney donor for his brother. Harold undergoes a George Bailey-like transformation.
